definition: GT objects per frame under the FROZEN v2 convention: union over {ego, selected collaborator} of params[vehicles], projected into the ego frame, CORNER-filtered against GT_RANGE (every corner must lie inside), de-duplicated by object id.
collaborator_rule: sec 2, nearest by lidar_pose[0:2], ties by ascending id, COM_RANGE 70 m
source: the frozen WP2 products, which ARE the v2 GT the E/L/F products were scored against

independent_corroboration.method: a third-party reconstruction from raw OPV2V yaml that imports NO dataset class from either side (V2-R37 C-1)
independent_corroboration.agreement: 1961 of 1980 frames agree EXACTLY; 19 differ by +-1 (one by +2), 16 boxes net
independent_corroboration.cause_of_the_19: boundary precision in the RECONSTRUCTION, not in WP2: 51 kept boxes lie within 0.10 m of the range edge and the reconstruction uses a 2-D yaw-only corner construction (no roll/pitch), which is easily ~0.1 m off on a rotated box. A handful of marginal boxes flip.
independent_corroboration.status: CORROBORATES the aggregate convention; NOT precise enough to be a per-frame golden reference, and is not used as one (V2-R37 C-1)

v1_reference_untouched: results/sensitivity/gt_object_stats.csv (mean_late_num_gt) is the v1 CENTRE-filter convention and is left exactly as it is. v1 is frozen; its historical definition stands. This file is a NEW v2 reference beside it, not a rewrite of it.
why_the_old_assertion_failed: score_arm.py compared a v2 arm against the v1 CENTRE-filter reference -- a convention mismatch, not a data fault. Centre filtering gives 27.78, corner filtering 26.83, and the arm was judged against the wrong one.
